```yaml
name: Pro Integration Tests
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'pro'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'pro'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: pro-integration-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate Pro submodule
        id: validate-submodule
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "pro" ]; then
            echo "Pro submodule not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "submodule_found=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run Pro integration tests
        if: steps.validate-submodule.outputs.submodule_found == 'true'
        run: npm run test:pro

      - name: Run Pro internal tests
        if: steps.validate-submodule.outputs.submodule_found == 'true'
        run: npm run test:pro-internal

      - name: Skip if no Pro token
        if: failure() && github.event_name != 'schedule'
        run: |
          echo "Skipping tests due to missing Pro token or submodule"
          exit 0
```
